title: Size-Dependent Bioaerosol Dynamics in the Middle Indo-Gangetic Basin: Bacterial Composition and Functional Characteristics Across Poultry, Agricultural, and Waste Management Sites
description: This study investigates the concentration, size distribution, taxonomic composition, and predicted functional characteristics of airborne bacterial communities across four anthropogenically distinct environments in Varanasi, India- an agricultural research farm, a commercial poultry facility, a municipal solid waste management facility, and a waste-to-charcoal plant. Bacterial communities were characterized using 16S rRNA gene V3-V4 amplicon sequencing.
